components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The page's one action colour, as a pill with a chevron.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #1f2de6; color: #fff; font: 500 16px/1 'Host Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary .ds-chev { transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1b28c8; } .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-chev { transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1f2de6; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(.985); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 44px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #dcdee2; color: #0b0c0e; font: 500 16px/1 'Host Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #cfd1d5; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1f2de6; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.description: Small pill naming an audience or a fact.

narrative.overview:
The page is a lane under bright, even light: a cool off-white ground, near-black ink, and a single cobalt mark that works like the bench lamp over a drill press. The light shows you exactly where to look. Everything else stays quiet and exact, so the numbers (PAP, speed, revs, pin-to-PAP, VAL angle) and the app's own screens carry the page.

Density is comfortable, not airy. Sections pair a short heading with real proof: a captured app screen, a printed drill sheet, a worked example, a ruled comparison. Depth comes from tone (ground, bench grey, white paper, one dark app window) rather than from shadows. The hero's dark window, the drilled ball over a lane seen from above, is the one heavy object on the page and the reason the rest can stay light.

The tone is a driller's: exact terms a pro shop trusts, plain words a bowler can follow. No decoration that doesn't explain something.
keyCharacteristics: Cool off-white ground (#eef0f3) with one cobalt accent (#1f2de6), used sparingly.
Host Grotesk throughout, medium weight with tight tracking for headings; JetBrains Mono for numbers and specs.
Soft corners (12–20px) on panels and cards; pill buttons and chips.
Flat at rest; hairline lines (ink at 11% / 20%) do the structuring.
Real app screens and printed sheets as the imagery, never stock or illustration.

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is the only saturated colour on the page. It marks action, selection or "yours", never decoration, and covers a small share of any screen.

rules.name: The Ink Floor Rule
rules.body: Text people read is 16px or more in Pin Black. Slate Muted is for captions and labels, never for paragraphs.

rules.name: The No Lone Word Rule
rules.body: Read text uses text-wrap: pretty; headings break by sense, not by width.

rules.name: The Real Object Rule
rules.body: Only things that exist off the page (paper, a screen, a window) cast a shadow. Cards and panels never do.

dos: Do use Bench-Lamp Cobalt (#1f2de6) only for action, selection and "yours".
Do show the real app and real printed sheets as the page's imagery, cropped so each ends on whole content.
Do keep read text at 16px or more in Pin Black, with text-wrap: pretty.
Do put numbers a driller would write down in JetBrains Mono.
Do structure with 1px hairlines and tonal surfaces before reaching for shadows.
donts: Don't add a second saturated colour or a gradient accent.
Don't put shadows on cards or panels; only paper, captures and the hero window cast one.
Don't set paragraphs in Slate Muted.
Don't use stock photos or illustration where an app screen or sheet can show the real thing.
